# Title: Sri Shyama Tour & Travels
# Tagline: Mathura Vrindavan Braj Yatra & Pilgrimage Tours

## About
Sri Shyama Tour & Travels is a pilgrimage tour operator based in Vrindavan,
Mathura district, Uttar Pradesh, India. Founded in 2015, we specialize in
sacred Braj Yatra (Braj Mandala) pilgrimage tours covering all 84 sacred
sites associated with Lord Krishna — including Mathura (birthplace),
Vrindavan, Gokul, Barsana, Nandgaon, Govardhan, and Radha Kund.

## Services
- Braj Yatra packages (2N/3D, 3N/4D with Agra, 84 Kos complete, 6N/7D custom)
- Govardhan Parikrama (21 km sacred circumambulation)
- Pickup from Delhi and Agra (cab service available)
- Local Braj-born guides fluent in Hindi, English, Bengali
- Vegetarian drivers and local pandit arrangements
- Same-day Mathura Vrindavan darshan tours

## FAQ
Q: What is Braj Yatra?
A: Braj Yatra is a sacred pilgrimage across the Braj Mandala — the 84-kosa
(about 300 km) region where Lord Krishna performed His pastimes. It covers
Mathura (birthplace), Vrindavan (ras-lila), Gokul (childhood), Barsana
(Radha's home), Nandgaon, and Govardhan Hill.

Q: How long is the complete 84 Kos Yatra?
A: The complete 84 Kos Braj Yatra takes 3-7 days depending on the pace and
depth of darshan at each site. We offer flexible durations.

Q: Do you provide pickup from Delhi or Agra?
A: Yes, we provide AC cab pickup from Delhi and Agra to Mathura Vrindavan,
with optional return drop.

Q: Are guides available?
A: Yes, all packages include dedicated Braj-born guides who understand the
spiritual significance of each site and speak Hindi, English, and Bengali.

Q: Can packages be customized?
A: Yes, all our packages are fully customizable — routes, duration,
accommodation, and group size. Share your sankalp and we craft the perfect
itinerary.
